conditions.label: VAT: régime simplifié
conditions.description: One annual VAT return (CA12) with two instalments.

conditions.label: Pays corporate tax (IS)
conditions.description: The default for an SAS or SARL; an EURL or SASU with a single individual owner may be taxed differently.

conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays salaries; the DSN is monthly.

profileFields.label: Dénomination sociale
profileFields.description: The company name in the articles.

profileFields.label: SIREN
profileFields.description: The 9-digit company number given at registration.

profileFields.label: RCS registration
profileFields.description: The trade and companies register entry (city and number).

profileFields.label: Activité (objet social)
profileFields.description: What the company does, as in the articles.

profileFields.label: Capital social
profileFields.description: In euros, as in the articles.

roles.label: Président
roles.description: The legal representative an SAS must have.

roles.label: Directeur général
roles.description: Optional, if the articles provide for one.

roles.label: Actionnaire
roles.description: Holds shares; an SASU has one.

setupSteps.title: Write and sign the articles (statuts)
setupSteps.description: The articles set the form, the name, the purpose, the registered office, the capital and how the company is run.

setupSteps.title: Deposit the share capital
setupSteps.description: Deposit the cash contributions in a bank account in the company's name; the money is released after registration.
setupSteps.authority: Bank, notary or Caisse des dépôts

setupSteps.title: Appoint the président
setupSteps.description: An SAS has a président, named in the articles or by the associates; the articles may add a directeur général.

setupSteps.title: Publish the legal notice of creation
setupSteps.description: Publish the notice in a newspaper or online service authorised in the département of the registered office. The price is fixed per département.

setupSteps.title: Register on the Guichet unique
setupSteps.description: Apply online at the Guichet des formalités des entreprises with the articles, the proof of the capital deposit and the notice's certificate. The company gets its SIREN and Kbis.

setupSteps.title: Open the professional tax account
setupSteps.description: VAT returns and payments are made in the company's professional space on impots.gouv.fr.

setupSteps.title: Open the business bank account
setupSteps.description: The deposit account becomes the company's account once it is registered.

obligations.title: Approve the annual accounts
obligations.description: The associates approve the accounts within six months of the financial year end.

obligations.title: File the annual accounts with the court registry
obligations.description: Within one month of the approval (two months when filed online). The date shown counts from a six-month approval.

obligations.title: Corporate tax return (liasse fiscale, 2065)
obligations.description: For a 31 December year end: by the 2nd working day after 1 May, with 15 more days online. For other year ends: within three months. The date shown is an estimate.

obligations.title: Corporate tax instalments
obligations.description: Four instalments on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December; the dates that apply depend on the year end.

obligations.title: VAT return (CA3), monthly
obligations.description: Between the 15th and the 24th of the following month; the exact date is in the company's professional space on impots.gouv.fr. The date shown is the earliest.

obligations.title: Annual VAT return (CA12)
obligations.description: By the 2nd working day after 1 May for the calendar year, with the balance paid then. Instalments of 55% in July and 40% in December.

obligations.title: VAT instalment (July)
obligations.description: 55% of the previous year's VAT, in July. Check the exact date in the professional space.

obligations.title: VAT instalment (December)
obligations.description: 40% of the previous year's VAT, in December. Check the exact date in the professional space.

obligations.title: Monthly payroll declaration (DSN)
obligations.description: By the 15th of the following month with fewer than 50 employees, by the 5th with 50 or more.
